name: Write short stories and personal narratives
description: Users requested the creation of varied short stories and personal narratives, often applying specific constraints such as word limits, required vocabulary lists, target audiences, or stylistic parameters like tense and perspective. Many prompts asked for fictional plots, including fables or school-based scenarios, while others sought non-fiction personal anecdotes or summaries.
